Definition: feminine of G4205; a strumpet; figuratively, an idolater:--harlot, whore.
BiblicalUsage: Porne is the harlot, and Scripture uses her two ways. In the Gospels she is a real woman: the harlots enter the kingdom before the religious, and Rahab the harlot is named in the roll of faith and in the line of Christ. In Revelation she becomes a picture, the great whore whose fall the heavens celebrate.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Rahab is the proof that no past disqualifies anyone from grace, and Babylon is the warning that seduction always ends in judgment. The same word holds both stories, and I must choose which one I belong to.
